1 /**
2  * v0 Face+Strip storage: dual-section Face narrative + fenced/JSON Strip
3  * and/or project-root strip.json. N=1 via cwd/--project; no registry.
4  */
5 
6 import fs from 'node:fs';
7 import { createHash } from 'node:crypto';
8 import path from 'node:path';
9 
10 export const FACE_FILE_NAME = 'ECGBERHT.md';
11 export const STRIP_FILE_NAME = 'strip.json';
12 export const STRIP_SCHEMA_ID = 'ecgberht-strip-v0';
13 
14 /** Face narrative field ids (human rewrite authority). */
15 export const FACE_NARRATIVE_FIELDS = Object.freeze([
16   'north_star',
17   'active_effort',
18   'why_next',
19   'human_wait',
20   'why_stakes',
21 ]);

23 /**
24  * Resolve N=1 project path: --project wins, else cwd. Zero registry.
25  * @param {{ project?: string|null, cwd?: string|null }} [opts]
26  * @returns {string}
27  */
28 export function resolveProjectPath(opts = {}) {
29   const project = opts.project;
30   if (typeof project === 'string' && project.trim()) {
31     return path.resolve(project.trim());
32   }
33   const cwd = opts.cwd ?? process.cwd();
34   return path.resolve(cwd);
35 }

37 /**
38  * Extract first JSON fence that looks like an ecgberht Strip (schema id or strip-shaped).
39  * Used for dual-section Face files; does not require loading full narrative for discovery.
40  * @param {string} markdown
41  * @returns {{ found: boolean, jsonText?: string, strip?: object, error?: string }}
42  */
43 export function extractStripFence(markdown) {
44   if (typeof markdown !== 'string' || !markdown) {
45     return { found: false, error: 'empty_markdown' };
46   }
47 
48   const fenceRe = /```(?:json)?\s*\r?\n([\s\S]*?)```/gi;
49   let match;
50   while ((match = fenceRe.exec(markdown)) !== null) {
51     const jsonText = match[1].trim();
52     if (!jsonText) continue;
53     if (!jsonText.includes(STRIP_SCHEMA_ID) && !/"schema"\s*:/.test(jsonText)) {
54       // Prefer fences that declare schema; still try parse if object-like
55       if (!jsonText.startsWith('{')) continue;
56     }
57     try {
58       const strip = JSON.parse(jsonText);
59       if (strip && typeof strip === 'object' && !Array.isArray(strip)) {
60         if (strip.schema === STRIP_SCHEMA_ID || typeof strip.phase === 'string') {
61           return { found: true, jsonText, strip };
62         }
63       }
64     } catch {
65       // try next fence
66     }
67   }
68   return { found: false, error: 'no_strip_fence' };
69 }
70 
71 /**
72  * True if text contains a discoverable Strip fence (cheap string check before full parse).
73  * @param {string} markdown
74  */
75 export function hasStripFenceMarker(markdown) {
76   if (typeof markdown !== 'string') return false;
77   return (
78     markdown.includes(STRIP_SCHEMA_ID) ||
79     /##\s*Strip\b/i.test(markdown)
80   );
81 }

83 /**
84  * Parse Face markdown into narrative sections by locked headings.
85  * @param {string} markdown
86  * @returns {{ ok: true, narrative: object, raw: string, strip_fence: object|null } | { ok: false, error: string }}
87  */
88 export function parseFaceDocument(markdown) {
89   if (typeof markdown !== 'string') {
90     return { ok: false, error: 'face_not_string' };
91   }
92 
93   const narrative = {
94     north_star: sectionBody(markdown, 'North star'),
95     active_effort: sectionBody(markdown, 'Active effort'),
96     why_next: sectionBody(markdown, 'Why next'),
97     human_wait: sectionBody(markdown, 'Human wait'),
98     why_stakes: sectionBody(markdown, 'Why stakes') || sectionBody(markdown, 'Why next'),
99   };
100 
101   const fence = extractStripFence(markdown);
102   return {
103     ok: true,
104     narrative,
105     raw: markdown,
106     strip_fence: fence.found ? fence.strip : null,
107   };
108 }
109 
110 /**
111  * @param {string} markdown
112  * @param {string} heading
113  */
114 function sectionBody(markdown, heading) {
115   const re = new RegExp(
116     `##\\s+${escapeRegExp(heading)}\\s*\\r?\\n([\\s\\S]*?)(?=\\r?\\n##\\s+|$)`,
117     'i',
118   );
119   const m = markdown.match(re);
120   return m ? m[1].trim() : '';
121 }
122 
123 function escapeRegExp(s) {
124   return s.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&');
125 }
126 
127 /**
128  * The North Star's revision: sha256 of the "## North star" section with
129  * blockquote markers, bold and rules stripped and whitespace folded, first 12
130  * hex - the same hash the cockpit reader computes (steward_campaign.read_map),
131  * so a goal_flip written here stands for the revision the cockpit shows. ''
132  * when the Face has no North Star.
133  * @param {string} markdown the Face
134  */
135 export function northStarRevision(markdown) {
136   // the reader's own section walk: a "## " heading opens a section, the next one closes it (an empty section is empty)
137   const body = [];
138   let inside = false;
139   for (const raw of String(markdown ?? '').split(/\r?\n/)) {
140     const heading = raw.match(/^##\s+(.+?)\s*$/);
141     if (heading) { inside = heading[1].trim().toLowerCase() === 'north star'; continue; }
142     if (inside) body.push(raw);
143   }
144   const lines = [];
145   for (const raw of body) {
146     const line = raw.replace(/^\s*>\s?/, '').replace(/\*\*/g, '');
147     if (/^\s*-{3,}\s*$/.test(line)) continue;
148     lines.push(line);
149   }
150   const goal = lines.join('\n').trim().replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
151   return goal ? createHash('sha256').update(goal, 'utf8').digest('hex').slice(0, 12) : '';
152 }
153 
154 /**
155  * Normalize / validate a Strip object (projection + optional append-only logs).
156  * @param {object|string} input
157  * @returns {{ ok: true, strip: object } | { ok: false, error: string, message?: string }}
158  */
159 export function parseStrip(input) {
160   let strip = input;
161   if (typeof input === 'string') {
162     try {
163       strip = JSON.parse(input);
164     } catch (e) {
165       return { ok: false, error: 'strip_json_parse', message: String(e?.message ?? e) };
166     }
167   }
168   if (!strip || typeof strip !== 'object' || Array.isArray(strip)) {
169     return { ok: false, error: 'strip_not_object' };
170   }
171 
172   const out = { ...strip };
173   if (!out.schema) out.schema = STRIP_SCHEMA_ID;
174   if (!Array.isArray(out.instruments)) out.instruments = Array.isArray(strip.instruments) ? [...strip.instruments] : [];
175   if (!Array.isArray(out.receipts)) out.receipts = Array.isArray(strip.receipts) ? [...strip.receipts] : [];
176   if (!Array.isArray(out.grasscatch)) out.grasscatch = Array.isArray(strip.grasscatch) ? [...strip.grasscatch] : [];
177   if (!Array.isArray(out.uncertainty_flags)) {
178     out.uncertainty_flags = Array.isArray(strip.uncertainty_flags) ? [...strip.uncertainty_flags] : [];
179   }
180   if (out.capacity !== 'known' && out.capacity !== 'unknown') {
181     out.capacity = 'unknown';
182   }
183   if (typeof out.anti_starvation_age_days !== 'number') {
184     out.anti_starvation_age_days =
185       typeof strip.anti_starvation_age_days === 'number' ? strip.anti_starvation_age_days : 0;
186   }
187   if (!out.negative_heartbeat || typeof out.negative_heartbeat !== 'object') {
188     out.negative_heartbeat = {
189       no_attention_needed: false,
190       why: null,
191       until: null,
192     };
193   }
194 
195   return { ok: true, strip: out };
196 }

198 /**
199  * Load project Face+Strip surfaces from disk (N=1 path).
200  * Prefers strip.json; falls back to ECGBERHT.md fence. Never invents Strip truth.
201  * @param {string} projectPath
202  * @returns {object}
203  */
204 export function loadProjectSurfaces(projectPath) {
205   const root = path.resolve(projectPath);
206   const stripPath = path.join(root, STRIP_FILE_NAME);
207   const facePath = path.join(root, FACE_FILE_NAME);
208 
209   const result = {
210     ok: true,
211     project_path: root,
212     face_path: null,
213     strip_path: null,
214     strip_source: null,
215     face: null,
216     strip: null,
217     face_loaded: false,
218     errors: [],
219   };
220 
221   if (fs.existsSync(stripPath) && fs.statSync(stripPath).isFile()) {
222     try {
223       const raw = fs.readFileSync(stripPath, 'utf8');
224       const parsed = parseStrip(raw);
225       if (parsed.ok) {
226         result.strip = parsed.strip;
227         result.strip_path = stripPath;
228         result.strip_source = 'strip.json';
229       } else {
230         result.errors.push(parsed);
231       }
232     } catch (e) {
233       result.errors.push({ error: 'strip_read_failed', message: String(e?.message ?? e) });
234     }
235   }
236 
237   if (fs.existsSync(facePath) && fs.statSync(facePath).isFile()) {
238     try {
239       const raw = fs.readFileSync(facePath, 'utf8');
240       const face = parseFaceDocument(raw);
241       if (face.ok) {
242         result.face = face;
243         result.face_path = facePath;
244         result.face_loaded = true;
245         if (!result.strip && face.strip_fence) {
246           const parsed = parseStrip(face.strip_fence);
247           if (parsed.ok) {
248             result.strip = parsed.strip;
249             result.strip_source = 'face_fence';
250           }
251         }
252       }
253     } catch (e) {
254       result.errors.push({ error: 'face_read_failed', message: String(e?.message ?? e) });
255     }
256   }
257 
258   if (!result.strip && !result.face) {
259     result.ok = false;
260     result.error = 'no_face_or_strip';
261   }
262 
263   return result;
264 }

266 /**
267  * Strip projection fields used for portfolio rank (no Face required).
268  * @param {object} strip
269  * @param {{ project_path?: string, strip_source?: string }} [meta]
270  */
271 export function toStripProjection(strip, meta = {}) {
272   const parsed = parseStrip(strip);
273   if (!parsed.ok) {
274     return null;
275   }
276   const s = parsed.strip;
277   return {
278     project_id: s.project_id ?? meta.project_id ?? null,
279     project_path: meta.project_path ?? null,
280     strip_source: meta.strip_source ?? null,
281     phase: s.phase ?? null,
282     active_effort: s.active_effort ?? null,
283     human_wait: s.human_wait ?? 'none',
284     capacity: s.capacity === 'known' ? 'known' : 'unknown',
285     negative_heartbeat: s.negative_heartbeat ?? {
286       no_attention_needed: false,
287       why: null,
288       until: null,
289     },
290     anti_starvation_age_days:
291       typeof s.anti_starvation_age_days === 'number' ? s.anti_starvation_age_days : 0,
292     next_recommended: s.next_recommended ?? null,
293     why_next: s.why_next ?? null,
294     uncertainty_flags: Array.isArray(s.uncertainty_flags) ? [...s.uncertainty_flags] : [],
295     tool_depth_cell: s.tool_depth_cell ?? null,
296     as_of: s.as_of ?? null,
297   };
298 }
